prose_status: Accepted after two independent full scientific/editorial reviews, targeted repairs and actual specified production checks.
code_validation: Executed Python checks for units, product scaling, population throughput, whole-blood-loss/cell-free-dilution distinction and invalid inputs. Node syntax and isolated mechanism-state/control checks passed; no browser acceptance claimed.

figures.role: Controlled local-injury platelet capture, activation and aggregation; schematic luminal/tissue compartments.

Controlled renal oxygen/EPO/marrow/circulating RBC feedback sequence, no physiological rate constants.

Reviewed bounded alternative: prepared clot SEM, separately identified pathological mouse-vessel SEM and original sectional mechanism. These do not establish normal human wall layers, natural tissue color or measured injury dynamics.

Actual colorized SEM reference for concave red-cell profiles and fibrin mesh; current Wellcome CC BY 4.0; no calibrated scale, species, vessel wall, secure platelet identification or motion/timing claims.
Actual mouse-skin-melanoma freeze-fracture SEM supports lumen/boundary/surrounding-tissue distinction only; no physiological injury or normal human wall claim.

limitations: Primary experiments were accessed only at abstract level: Orzalesi/Hay 1971 and human-blood VWF/receptor flow-chamber study 1988.
Tillman review reopen returned a browser check; prior documented project introduction-level read is disclosed. UniProt direct reopen returned JS fallback but indexed reviewed record was readable.
Legacy Reactome coagulation IDs returned 404; current initiation/amplification/fibrin/regulation pathway records were opened instead.
Numerical blood volumes/counts/MCVs and assay patterns are explicitly synthetic. Approximate 120-day normal RBC lifespan supports stationary throughput, not an exponential removal law.
No modeled coagulation rates, EPO gains/delays, fibrin mechanics or patient-specific treatment comparisons; drug mechanism categories are not prescribing recommendations.
Presentation phase timings are schematic, not measured biological kinetics.
Prepared clot species/donor unknown; vessel image is pathological mouse tissue, not normal human wall anatomy.
Source topic coverage uses captions and bounded sampled stills, not continuous audio/video review.
Private browser print proof is not a clean public PDF deliverable.
coverage_basis: Core topic spans and justified exclusions assessed in two independent full reviews; scientific/temporal repairs and production enlargement received targeted checks. Captions plus bounded stills, not continuous recording review.

production_validation.scope: Actual responsive reader, all mechanism phases, keyboard pan, playback, reduced-motion and print-proof checks with explicit limits.
